title: Kings and Prophets Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of the kings and prophets of Israel and Judah!

questions.question: Who was Israel's first king?
questions.explanation: Saul was Israel's first king, anointed by the prophet Samuel.

questions.question: Why did God reject Saul as king?
options: He was disobedient to God's commands
questions.explanation: God rejected Saul because he repeatedly disobeyed God's commands. Samuel told him, 'To obey is better than sacrifice.'

questions.question: What did God look at when choosing David as king?
questions.explanation: God told Samuel, 'The LORD looks at the heart.' David was chosen because of his faithful heart.

questions.question: What did Solomon ask God for?
questions.explanation: Solomon asked God for wisdom to lead His people, and God was so pleased that He gave Solomon wisdom, riches, and honor.

questions.question: Why did the kingdom of Israel split into two?
options: Rehoboam refused to lighten the people's burden
questions.explanation: Rehoboam listened to foolish advice and made the people's burden heavier, causing ten tribes to rebel and form the northern kingdom.

questions.question: What happened on Mount Carmel when Elijah prayed?
options: Fire fell from heaven and consumed the sacrifice
questions.explanation: God sent fire from heaven that consumed Elijah's sacrifice, the wood, the stones, and even the water, proving He is the true God.

questions.question: How old was Josiah when he became king?
questions.explanation: Josiah became king of Judah when he was only eight years old, and he chose to follow God.

questions.question: What important book was found during repairs to the temple in Josiah's time?
questions.explanation: The high priest Hilkiah found the Book of the Law (the Scriptures) during temple repairs. When Josiah heard it read, he led the nation back to God.
